scope: S014,600722.SH,2020-01-01..2026-10-15; existing pinned native inputs and EX004..EX006 evidence only; fully seen development pool; no independent validation claim
question: Can completed-day market structure, volume participation and observed holding path distinguish the net value of continuing a position from exiting at the next TXE-feasible open?

mechanisms.structure: Persistence requires price remaining above its medium-term reference and maintaining distance from recent support; a one-day negative return alone may be normal noise.
mechanisms.participation: Volume-weighted close location and positive/negative return participation may distinguish sustained pressure from an isolated pullback. They are daily-bar proxies, not observed investor flows.
mechanisms.holding_path: How much of an already-observed gain has been surrendered, in units of recent volatility, may distinguish normal consolidation from deterioration. This is an incremental representation of the same price source.

sample: Use EX006 common-mature, filled attempts at the midpoint checkpoint for H=5,10,20, decision index>=60. Each horizon separately has one observation per decision session. Keep every eligible year, censoring and nonfills separately; no complete account.
label: continue_gain = inherited original fixed-exit net cash return minus inherited next-feasible-exit net cash return, both same actual quantity and initial100000CNY, both side0.001 fee. Positive means continuing to the declared fixed horizon is better. Earliest exit after completed D, never D close. Costs of capital/re-entry opportunities are not represented.

features.time: Completed D and earlier bars/position only. First60sessions warm up inside authorized interval; no pre-window data. No D+1 price or exit outcome in features.

estimators: Fixed ridge penalty10 with train-only centering/scaling, baseline, each single-group augmentation, full, each full-minus-one group (8 total). Fixed depth3,min_samples_leaf40,seed13 regression tree on baseline/full to check interactions (2). Training label mean is a separate simpler control. No parameter search or automatic model selection.
direct_controls: Two predefined completed-day continuation indicators: close>=MA20 and MA5>=MA20; close>=minimum previous5 closes. They are contrasts, not selected production rules.
training: Expanding2020 onward; test years2023/24/25/26. Training maturity strictly before the first test decision of the year; all preprocessing fit on training only. Decisions near year end with immature labels are excluded from next-year training. Cutoff stays2026-10-15.
decision_probe: For each independent checkpoint, continue if predicted continue_gain>0, otherwise next feasible exit. Report prediction MAE, continue/exit coverage, mean realized checkpoint choice vs always-fixed-hold and vs baseline-ridge, selected continuation label, forgone upside, and worst completed-close movement after earliest exit. This probe is not a sequential stopping policy, candidate or account.
comparisons: 13 probes x3horizons x2paired comparators=78 nominal contrasts including trivial/repeated controls, prior78 gives nominal history156. Confidence diagnostics use within-year20-session circular block resampling5000, preserving paired dates. Pooled mean weights decision observations. Report all years, omit2026, omit best3 positive decision improvements; intervals do not establish independent replication or new hard gates.
counterevidence: Ablate each group; compare simple controls and full nonlinear expression; report years with losses/negative increment, leave2026out, opportunity cost of early exits, sample/coverage changes. If only a particular year or thin selection drives improvement, keep that limitation. Do not reverse a losing rule automatically.
